blocks.text: Origin / creation. Reduction-era researchers and caregivers encoded unresolved orientations, adaptive structures, and meaningful developmental conditions into early cores, then raised proto-pets in protected environments.
Identity / human status. Artificial DBA specialists. “Pet” is a later interface term; they did not design beings as human possessions.
Importance. They learned that cores must permit different lives under different care, and that vulnerability must create perspective without imposing suffering as a quota.
Decline or transformation. Their work moved into Seed Audits, stable-core certification, and final environmental preparation. Complete caretakers then withdrew.
Final status / surviving function. No caretaker remains in supervisory control. Core adaptability, care loops, Path potential, and the prohibition on forced ancient identity preserve their work.
